post.title: Congressman sold up to $1.6M of Big Tech in ONE day 👀
post.description: Rep. Pete Sessions disclosed 6 Big Tech sales dated Oct 2 (Apple, Microsoft, Amazon, Alphabet, Nvidia, Tesla). Rep. Michael Rulli disclosed selling Alphabet on Oct 16. Amounts are disclosed ranges; disclosures can lag trades by up to 45 days. Source: STOCK Act filings via Tip Ranks; prices via Robinhood (Oct 2 close → Nov 2 close). Not financial advice and not an allegation of wrongdoing.

scenes.say: This congressman sold up to one point six million dollars of Big Tech stock... in a single day.
Representative Pete Sessions disclosed six sales, all on October second: Apple, Microsoft, Amazon, Alphabet, Nvidia, and Tesla.
So how did those stocks do after? Alphabet is down nearly nineteen percent. Nvidia, almost fourteen. And Tesla? Up nine.
scenes.title: SINCE THOSE SALES
scenes.sub: Share price, Oct 2 close → Nov 2 close

scenes.say: And he wasn't the only one. Representative Michael Rulli sold up to one hundred thousand dollars of Alphabet on October sixteenth. Thirteen days later... the stock fell almost thirteen percent in one day.
Also disclosed this week: Senator Sheldon Whitehouse sold Microsoft, Representative Cleo Fields bought Nvidia, and Representative John McGuire sold Broadcom.
scenes.title: ALSO DISCLOSED

scenes.say: Quick reminder: filings can lag up to forty five days, and amounts are ranges. This isn't proof of wrongdoing, or financial advice. Which trade surprised you most? Tell me in the comments, and subscribe for every week's Congress trades.
